pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Taking His Pocket Watch from His Waistcoat Pocket Near Alice on a Grassy Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit taking out his pocket watch beside Alice on a grassy riverbank, with flowers growing near the water. His spectacles, bow tie, and dangling watch chain add small details to the coloring sheet, while Alice's apron and the curving stream provide larger open spaces.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Rushing Along a Woodland Path with His Pocket Watch and Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit rushes along a woodland path in this printable coloring page, carrying an umbrella and holding his large pocket watch above his shoulder. Mushrooms, pebbles, and tall trees surround his running pose. The coloring sheet combines broad areas on his coat and belly with smaller watch numerals and scattered leaves.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Disappearing into the Rabbit Hole Beneath a Hedge as Alice Follows Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows the White Rabbit into a rabbit hole beneath a leafy hedge as Alice kneels on the grass and watches him disappear. His fluffy tail, raised feet, and hanging watch remain visible at the entrance. Small flowers and exposed roots frame the two characters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Hurrying Around a Corner in the Underground Passage as Alice Follows Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit hurries around an underground corner in this printable coloring page while Alice follows through an arched passage lined with bricks and hanging roots. He holds up his pocket watch as he runs. A wall lantern, small door, and scattered floor stones add enclosed details around the larger character shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Carrying a Folding Fan and Kid Gloves Through the Hall of Doors Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the White Rabbit carrying a folding fan and kid gloves through the Hall of Doors, surrounded by doors of different sizes. Floral decorations divide the fan into narrow panels, while tiny trim details mark the gloves. His long coat and the tiled floor create broader sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Dropping His Fan and Gloves When Giant Alice Calls to Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Giant Alice calls to the White Rabbit in this printable coloring page as he drops his fan and gloves while running away along a narrow path. Her oversized hand reaches above the falling objects, emphasizing their difference in scale. The coloring sheet includes his pocket watch, a few flowers, and open areas around the figures.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Searching the Grass for His Missing Gloves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit searching the grass for his missing gloves, bending forward with both paws among long leaves and tall daisies. His round spectacles and looping watch chain sit above the dense plants. Broad coat panels contrast with slender grass blades and small flower petals on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Mistaking Alice for Mary Ann and Sending Her to Fetch His Gloves Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit mistakes Alice for Mary Ann in this printable coloring page, gesturing toward his cottage as he sends her to fetch his gloves. Alice points at herself while he spreads his arms beside the winding path. Mushrooms, a picket fence, and the cottage roof supply additional shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Opening the Front Door of His Cottage Beneath Its Brass Nameplate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit opening his cottage door beneath its nameplate, with a pocket watch held against his buttoned waistcoat and coat. A lantern hangs beside the rounded doorway, and paving stones lead up to the entrance. The coloring sheet offers small chain links alongside broad door planks and clothing panels.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Calling for Mary Ann from the Foot of His Cottage Staircase Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit calls for Mary Ann from the foot of his cottage staircase in this printable coloring page, cupping one paw beside his open mouth. He holds his pocket watch with the other paw beneath his bow tie. The coloring sheet includes straight stair treads, a rounded banister finial, and a small window above him.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Trying to Open the Bedroom Door Blocked by Giant Alice Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the White Rabbit trying to open the bedroom door blocked by giant Alice, whose dress fills much of the small room. He reaches toward the handle while holding his watch, and Alice crouches beside the doorway. Large skirt sections dominate this coloring sheet, with smaller floorboards and door panels below.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Ducking Beneath Giant Alice's Hand Outside His Bedroom Window Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit ducks beneath giant Alice's hand outside his bedroom window in this printable coloring page, clutching his watch while crouching beside flowering cottage walls. Her arm extends through the open casement above his ears. Ivy leaves, daisies, paving stones, and his patterned waistcoat create many smaller sections within this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Tumbling into the Cucumber Frame Below His Cottage Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit tumbling into a cucumber frame below his cottage window, with his feet raised and pocket watch swinging outward. Cucumber vines curl around the partly open frame, and flower boxes flank the window above. Glass panels, leafy shapes, and his ruffled collar give this coloring sheet varied details.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Asking Pat the Gardener to Help Remove the Giant Arm from His Window Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit asks Pat the gardener for help in this printable coloring page as a giant arm stretches out through the open window above them. Pat wears a broad hat and overalls while holding a shovel, and the rabbit gestures toward him. Flowers and cottage brickwork add smaller sections around the characters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Directing Bill the Lizard Up a Ladder Toward the Cottage Chimney Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit directing Bill the Lizard up a ladder toward the cottage chimney, pointing above the flowers in his garden. Bill's long spotted tail curves beside the ladder rungs as he climbs toward the roof. The coloring sheet also includes a thatched roof, diamond windowpanes, and a rounded cottage door.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Calling for the Garden Animals to Catch Bill the Lizard as He Flies from the Chimney Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit calls for the garden animals to catch Bill the Lizard in this printable coloring page as Bill flies above the cottage chimney. Two small animals reach upward beneath his outstretched limbs and curling tail. The coloring sheet includes individual chimney bricks, patches of thatch, and flowers surrounding the rabbit's wide calling gesture.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Checking on Bill the Lizard While Two Guinea Pigs Help Him Recover Beside the Garden Hedge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit checking on Bill the Lizard while two guinea pigs help him recover beside a hedge dotted with leaves. The rabbit kneels behind Bill and rests a paw on his head as the guinea pigs hold his arms. Their grouped poses fill this coloring sheet above scattered grass tufts.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Supervising a Wheelbarrow of Pebbles Outside His Crowded Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit supervises a wheelbarrow of pebbles outside his cottage in this printable coloring page, pointing down at the rounded stones beside the garden path. A few pebbles lie below the barrow's large spoked wheel. Broad coat and barrow panels contrast with small flowers and window sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Asking the Dodo for Help as Giant Alice Fills His House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts the White Rabbit asking the Dodo for help as giant Alice fills his cottage, with her arm extending through a window. The Dodo wears a tall hat and holds a cane while the rabbit points toward the house. Alice's face peeks over the roof, adding another focal detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Trying to Stop the Dodo from Piling His Furniture Beside the Cottage for a Fire Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit tries to stop the Dodo piling furniture for a fire in this printable coloring page, raising both paws beside the cottage garden path. The Dodo carries a chair toward a stack of household furniture while looking back at him. Chair spindles, cabinet panels, and the thatched cottage provide contrasting sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Watching Tiny Alice Emerge from His Carrot Patch After Shrinking Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit watching tiny Alice emerge from his carrot patch after shrinking, surrounded by broad leaves rising from the soil. He bends toward her with a pocket watch in one paw and the other raised. The coloring sheet emphasizes their different sizes with large carrot tops and Alice's small apron.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Hurrying Away from His Cottage Through a Garden of Talking Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit hurries away from his cottage through a garden of talking flowers in this printable coloring page, holding his watch close to his waistcoat. Smiling flower faces lean toward the path, and roses climb a garden arch behind him. Numerous petals, leaves, and paving stones make this a closely detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Interrupting the Mad Hatter's Tea Party While Checking His Pocket Watch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit interrupting the Mad Hatter's tea party while checking his pocket watch, with one foot lifted beside the table. The Hatter pauses with a teacup in his hand beneath his tall hat. Teapots, saucers, cups, and the draped tablecloth add separate shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Watching the Mad Hatter Remove Gears from His Pocket Watch with a Fork Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit watches the Mad Hatter remove gears from his pocket watch with a fork in this printable coloring page, standing beside the crowded tabletop. The open watch reveals toothed wheels, with loose gears scattered nearby and a spoon in the Hatter's other hand. His numbered hat card adds another small detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Dodging His Bouncing Pocket Watch as It Scatters Teacups Across the Tea Table Coloring Page
pages.description: A bouncing pocket watch sends teacups flying as the White Rabbit dodges beside the tea table in this printable coloring page, spreading both paws in surprise. Tea splashes from floral cups, saucers tilt through the air, and one foot lifts above a chair. Curving motion marks emphasize the action throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Holding His Flattened Pocket Watch Beside the March Hare's Mallet Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit holds his flattened pocket watch beside the March Hare's mallet in this printable coloring page, looking down through round spectacles at its bent face. A long chain loops between his paws, while the patched mallet rests in the grass. This coloring sheet leaves plenty of open background around the small central scene.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Being Ushered Away from the Tea Party by the Mad Hatter and March Hare Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter and March Hare ushering the White Rabbit away from their tea party as he carries his pocket watch. The Hatter guides his shoulder while the Hare points toward the edge of the scene. A teapot, patterned cups, and a heart-backed chair remain behind them on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Announcing the Queen of Hearts with a Trumpet at the Palace Garden Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit announces the Queen of Hearts with a trumpet in this printable coloring page, standing at the palace garden entrance between two spear-carrying guards. A heart banner hangs from the trumpet, with tassels along its lower edge. Castle turrets, open gates, and rose bushes fill the background of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Marching in the Royal Procession Among Heart Shaped Banners and Card Soldiers Coloring Page
pages.description: Marching with the royal procession, the White Rabbit carries a bannered trumpet in this printable coloring page while card soldiers follow through a formal palace garden. Heart designs decorate his tunic, the soldiers' banners, and the clipped hedges. The coloring sheet includes broad costume panels and paving tiles alongside smaller ruff folds and hanging tassels.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Bowing Before the Queen of Hearts at Her Garden Throne Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit bowing before the Queen of Hearts at her garden throne, holding a trumpet down beside his ceremonial tunic. She sits with a heart-topped scepter and extends one hand toward him. Playing-card symbols, diamond upholstery, and rose petals provide smaller sections around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Escorting the Tiny King of Hearts Along a Formal Garden Path Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit escorts the tiny King of Hearts along a formal garden path in this printable coloring page, carrying his watch beside the King's tall crown. Hearts cover the King's robe and scepter, while shaped topiary and hedge arches line their route. The coloring sheet contrasts the small royal figure with the rabbit's long ears and coat.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Standing on Tiptoe to Whisper to Alice Beside the Croquet Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: Standing on tiptoe beside the croquet ground, the White Rabbit whispers to Alice in this printable coloring page as she kneels and leans close to listen. He cups a paw beside his mouth while holding his watch behind him. A mallet and croquet hoop sit among daisies beneath the rose bushes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Watching Alice Struggle with a Flamingo Mallet During the Royal Croquet Game Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit watches Alice struggle with a flamingo mallet during the royal croquet game in this printable coloring page, holding his watch beside the lawn. Alice grips the bird as its long neck bends toward a hedgehog below. A card soldier and hoop stand behind them, adding extra character details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Pointing Out a Runaway Hedgehog Beneath a Card Soldier's Croquet Arch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit pointing out a runaway hedgehog beneath a card soldier's croquet arch, with his free arm stretched behind him. The soldier bends into a bridge on gloved hands and booted feet as the hedgehog scurries below. Heart symbols and scattered flowers add small details to this open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Stepping Aside as the Queen of Hearts Angrily Interrupts the Croquet Game Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit steps aside as the Queen of Hearts angrily interrupts the croquet game in this printable coloring page, clutching his watch while she points. Her crown, high collar, and heart-patterned gown tower above the rabbit. A flamingo, hedgehog, and croquet hoop occupy the grass beneath shaped hedges on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Hurrying from the Croquet Garden Toward the Courtroom with a Parchment Scroll Coloring Page
pages.description: Carrying a parchment scroll, the White Rabbit hurries from the croquet garden toward the courtroom in this printable coloring page, with coat tails lifting behind him. A ribbon secures the rolled paper in his paw. Roses border the stone path, and heart-marked flags rise above the arched entrance in the background of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Standing Beside the Crowned King of Hearts as the Stolen Tarts Trial Begins Coloring Page
pages.description: The stolen tarts trial begins in this printable coloring page with the White Rabbit standing beside the crowned King of Hearts, holding a scroll and trumpet. Heart-shaped tarts sit on a pedestal table in front of the royal platform. The coloring sheet includes repeated hearts on the King's robe, the rabbit's tunic, and a hanging banner.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Blowing Three Trumpet Blasts Before the Court of Animal Jurors Coloring Page
pages.description: Blowing three trumpet blasts before the court, the White Rabbit stands beneath animal jurors in this printable coloring page, with a heart banner hanging from his instrument. An owl, crowned lion, and fox look down from tall chairs. Their capes and the courtroom's draped curtains add varied shapes above the rabbit on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Unrolling the Accusation Scroll Beside the Table of Stolen Tarts Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit unrolls the accusation scroll beside a table of stolen tarts in this printable coloring page, pointing at the long sheet through his round spectacles. The paper curls onto the grass beneath his feet. Fluted tart cases and round fruit decorations add small shapes beside the broad scroll and tablecloth on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Calling the Mad Hatter to Testify with His Teacup and Bread and Butter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit calling the Mad Hatter to testify as the Hatter approaches with a teacup and slice of bread and butter. The rabbit holds a scroll and gestures toward the royal court behind them. Heart banners, spear-carrying guards, and decorated floor tiles give this coloring sheet a detailed courtroom setting.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Raising One PAW to Call for Silence as the Animal Jurors Write on Their Slates Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit raises a paw to call for silence in this printable coloring page while animal jurors write on their slates behind his buttoned waistcoat. He holds a rolled paper and places one finger near his mouth. An owl, fox, squirrel, and badger surround him, adding distinct ears, tails, and clothing to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Quietly Advising the King of Hearts While the Duchess's Cook Holds Her Pepper Pot Coloring Page
pages.description: Quietly advising the King of Hearts, the White Rabbit leans beside his throne in this printable coloring page while the Duchess's cook holds her pepper pot. The cook stands behind them in an apron and tall hat. Heart-shaped crown points and the King's spotted robe border supply small repeated details across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Calling Alice to the Witness Stand as the Jurors Turn Toward Her Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit calls Alice to the witness stand in this printable coloring page as the seated jurors turn toward her beside the courtroom's stepped railing. He gestures with one paw and carries a rolled paper with the other. Faces crowd the upper bench, while Alice's bow, skirt folds, and the wood panels divide this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Stepping Away from the Jury Box as Growing Alice Accidentally Overturns It Coloring Page
pages.description: Growing Alice accidentally overturns the jury box as the White Rabbit steps away in this printable coloring page, holding his watch beneath the tilting wooden benches. Animal jurors cling to the rails while loose papers and a gavel fly above them. Alice's large dress and the slanted box create the main shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Presenting a Newly Discovered Folded Letter as Evidence in the Trial Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit presenting a newly discovered folded letter as evidence in the trial, lifting the creased paper beside the court bench. He carries a trumpet in his other paw and wears a ruff above his heart-covered tunic. A gavel and distant card soldiers complete the sparse courtroom background on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Wearing Spectacles While Reading the Mysterious Evidence Verses Aloud Coloring Page
pages.description: Wearing spectacles, the White Rabbit reads the mysterious evidence verses aloud in this printable coloring page, holding a long written scroll beside a small courtroom stool. His free paw opens outward while his watch hangs at his hip. Wavy writing marks, ruff folds, and heart panels add detail to the otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Showing the Unsigned Evidence Paper to the Knave of Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit shows the unsigned evidence paper to the Knave of Hearts in this printable coloring page while the Queen watches from her throne behind them. The Knave looks down with his hands clasped in front of his tunic. Large hearts decorate their clothing, with finer details in crowns, sleeves, and floorboards on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Looking Up from His Scroll as Giant Alice Challenges the Queen of Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit looks up from his scroll as giant Alice challenges the Queen of Hearts in this printable coloring page, standing beneath Alice's wide skirt. Alice keeps one hand at her waist while the Queen raises a fist beside her scepter. Small card guards and a rose bush emphasize the scale difference on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Sheltering Behind the Courtroom Lectern as the Playing Cards Rise into the Air Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit shelters behind the courtroom lectern as playing cards rise into the air in this printable coloring page, gripping the edge beneath his bow tie. Alice raises her hands nearby while a crowned ruler points from the court bench. Hearts, clubs, diamonds, and spades distinguish the airborne card figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit Frowning at the King of Hearts as Alice Gives Her Courtroom Testimony Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit frowning at the King of Hearts as Alice gives her courtroom testimony, gesturing from a raised witness stand. The rabbit holds an open scroll while the King sits behind the high bench. Repeated hearts and rectangular wood panels divide the uncluttered courtroom scene on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in White Rabbit's Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: In his garden, the White Rabbit checks a pocket watch and holds a cane in this printable coloring page, wearing checked trousers beneath a striped waistcoat. Tall flowers stand beside the curved path, with a picket fence and leafy tree farther back. The clothing patterns and Roman watch numerals add fine sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in Royal Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit stands in the royal throne room in this printable coloring page, carrying a trumpet and pocket watch while wearing a flower-trimmed top hat. His ruffled collar rests above a heart-decorated coat, with an empty crowned throne behind him. Shield banners, curtains, and floor tiles add separate background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in Heart Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the White Rabbit in a heart garden, holding his watch and trumpet beneath a sweeping arch of roses and curling leaves. Hearts decorate his waistcoat and the trumpet banner, with a distant castle beyond the path. Layered rose petals and scattered flowers give this coloring sheet many small enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in Wonderland Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: At Wonderland Palace, the White Rabbit points to his oversized pocket watch in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath an ornate arch between turreted clock towers. Hearts and spirals decorate his waistcoat, and triangular bunting hangs overhead. Wide paving stones and narrow tower windows provide contrasting background shapes around him on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in Chess Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit poses in a chess garden in this printable coloring page, holding a pocket watch and cane topped with a small rabbit head. Giant chess pieces stand behind him on a tiled board, including a horse-headed knight. Flowers and heart shapes on his waistcoat add smaller decorative sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in March Hare's House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the White Rabbit inside the March Hare's house, displaying his watch beside a tea table while standing on a fringed rug. Shelves of bottles, jars, and teapots fill the stone-walled room behind him. His striped waistcoat, the diamond windowpanes, and exposed ceiling beams add fine detail throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit in White Rabbit's House Coloring Page
pages.description: Inside his house, the White Rabbit holds his pocket watch by its chain in this printable coloring page, standing beneath framed pictures and a wall clock. A small lamp sits on the table below the window, while an arched doorway opens beside him. His broad coat panels and the wooden floorboards create clear spaces across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland White Rabbit on Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: The White Rabbit stands on a riverbank in this printable coloring page, holding his pocket watch toward the viewer and resting his other paw on a cane. One ear bends above his spectacles, and a loose necktie hangs over his waistcoat. Flowers and a winding river lead toward a distant tree on this coloring sheet.
